mechanism_claims.claim_text: A(A1R, A8R, I17K) retains antibacterial activity and shows anti-biofilm attachment, formation-inhibition, and dispersal activity against A. baumannii.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: A(A1R, A8R, I17K) and AR-23 comparator
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm effect is a phenotype/activity claim, not a direct anti-biofilm molecular mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD and sequence/biophysical analysis support the design rationale that changing the position of positively charged residues alters helicity, hydrophobicity, amphipathicity, and selectivity.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biophysical context supports design rationale but is not alone a direct antimicrobial mechanism.
